analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 35.6으로 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 히스토그램 -101.8213으로 악화 지속. 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 22,855원으로 동일하여 횡보 패턴 확인. 현재가 23,710원은 스윙 지지선 23,100원 상단에 위치하나, SMA5 24,876원, SMA20 27,627원 등 단기 이동평균선 하회. 변동성 ATR 1,931원 대비 손절폭 1.3배(2,510원) 설정 시, 진입가 23,710원 기준 손절 21,200원, 목표가 26,220원(손익비 1.01)으로 손익비 미달. 매수 진입은 RSI 30 하회 및 MACD 개선 확인 후, 매도 진입은 스윙 저항선 24,575원 돌파 실패 시 고려.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI at 35.6, entering oversold territory, and MACD histogram at -101.8213, continuing to worsen. The 5-day low and 20-day low are both $22,855, confirming a sideways pattern. The current price of $23,710 is above the swing support of $23,100 but below short-term moving averages like SMA5 at $24,876 and SMA20 at $27,627. With an ATR of $1,931, a stop loss of 1.3x ATR ($2,510) from the entry of $23,710 would be $21,200, and a target of $26,220 yields a risk-reward ratio of 1.01, which is below the required 1.5. Entry for buying will be considered after RSI falls below 30 and MACD shows improvement. Entry for selling will be considered if the swing resistance at $24,575 fails to break.

[Trend Position]
· Current price ($23,710) vs SMA5 ($24,876)/SMA20 ($27,627)/SMA50 ($32,024): Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, confirming a weak position.
· Significant drop relative to SMA100 ($34,205)/SMA200 ($36,505), indicating continued weakening of the long-term trend.
· 52-week position (17.2%): Approaching historical low levels, a zone for exploring potential rebounds.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.7→35.6): Entering oversold territory, with bearish momentum persisting.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-60.8130→-101.8213): Bearish trend continuing, worsening after a death cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band at $22,142): Approaching the lower band, confirming oversold pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($23,100): Above current price, a zone for confirming short-term support.
· Swing resistance ($24,575): Above current price, a break above could signal a short-term rebound.
· 5-day/20-day price pattern (5-day low $22,855, 20-day low $22,855): Sideways pattern confirmed, lacking directional conviction.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.29x): Average trading volume, indicating moderate confidence in price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Holding off on buy entries due to RSI in oversold territory and worsening MACD. Consider buying if support at $23,100 holds and RSI recovers above 30.
